stem: A new genetic accession arrives with complete source records but no plant-health screening. What is the strongest intake status?
choices: Identity can be recorded, but integration should remain controlled until plant-health risk is evaluated
Immediate release to mother stock because provenance is known
Discard provenance because health status is unknown
Treat all existing stock instead of evaluating the new accession
rationale: Identity/provenance and plant-health status are separate intake controls. Complete source records do not eliminate quarantine or screening needs.
